text: Nde o hewtunoo ka ɓunndu Madyana, ndu ɓe yarnirta ɗam, o tawi jamaa yimɓe no yarna daabeeji mun, o tawi kadi rewɓe ɗiɗo, no jogitii dammi mun, habbii haa yimɓe ɓen yarna. Annabi Muusaa maakani ɓe: Ko haɗi on yarnidugol e yimɓe ɓen? Ɓe wi'i: Ko men woowti, ko martagol habboo, haa gaynaakooɓe ɓen pottoo; fii wata men jillondir e maɓɓe, baaba amen, ko mawɗo nayeejo, o hippataa yarnugol, tawi bee men yarna menen, dammi amen ɗin.
